parole.significato: polyglot (one who has mastered (especially when able to speak) several languages)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Attic Greek πολύγλωττος (polúglōttos, “many-tongued, polyglot”), alternative form of πολύγλωσσος (polúglōssos), from πολύς (polús, “many”) + γλῶττα (glôtta, “tongue, language”).
